ios.desc:
Your phone is now a full coding environment. pocket/grammer runs AI coding agents with open models that live entirely on your device — no account, no cloud required — and shows you what it built in a live preview, right on your screen.

AN AGENT THAT PLANS, THEN CODES - Ask for a feature in plain language. pocket/grammer asks clarifying questions, then writes a step-by-step plan you can review before a single line changes. Hand the plan to code mode and watch each step execute — with history for every file it touches.

REAL MODELS, REALLY ON-DEVICE - Download open models sized to your device — Qwen 2.5 Coder, Qwen 2.5 Instruct, Qwen 3, and SmolLM2 — and run them entirely offline. Your code never leaves your phone unless you tell it to.

A REAL WORKSPACE - Multi-tab code editor with syntax highlighting and autocomplete 
• Diagnostics that catch syntax errors and unbalanced brackets as you type 
• Regex-powered search across every file in the project 
• A file tree you can drag to rearrange, with rename, copy, and delete • File history: step back to any earlier version of any file

LIVE PREVIEW - Run web projects instantly in the built-in preview. Switch between fit, mobile, and tablet viewports, and watch console output and errors in a dedicated panel — the preview reloads automatically as the agent writes code.

GITHUB IN, CODE OUT - Browse a GitHub repository and import its files into any workspace, then let the agent build on them.

BRING YOUR OWN KEY - Prefer frontier models? Add your own API keys for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint (LiteLLM works great). Keys are stored securely on your device, and you choose which role — planning or coding — uses cloud versus local.

YOUR DESKTOP, PAIRED TO YOUR PHONE - Open your workspace in any browser on the same network and keep using the IDE you love — VS Code, Cursor, or any of them — with your phone doing the AI work. One-time purchase, unlimited devices on your Apple ID.

FREE TO START, YOURS FOREVER - Every mobile feature is free. Desktop Access begins with a 7-day free trial, then unlocks with a single $19.99 purchase — never a subscription.

PRIVACY FIRST - No account required. On-device models work in airplane mode, and cloud providers are only called when you choose them.

quotes.text:
I have an old Intel Mac so I was excited when I got a new iPhone recently that could run LLMs. However, I was disappointed to discover there was no good way to transfer code from an LLM app to an IDE so I built my own.

pocket/grammer runs on your iPhone and connects to any browser through a local WiFi connection with a desktop client. Import, export projects and even connect to VS Code or Cursor.

The app is free and the desktop client is a $19.99 IAP after a 7 day trial.

Check it out and let me know what you think.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pocket-grammer/id6762562983
